data.one_liner: Reactive stream wrapper around sqflite for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Sqlbrite wraps sqflite databases to introduce reactive stream semantics to SQL operations. Queries return streams that emit new data immediately and again whenever the underlying table is modified.
use_when: You want reactive SQL queries in Flutter using sqflite and RxDart.
You need automatic query re-execution when tables are updated.
avoid_when: You need a full ORM or type-safe query mechanism.
strengths: Integrates seamlessly with sqflite and RxDart.
Provides convenient extension methods like mapToOne and mapToList.
Allows full control of query notification frequency using RxDart operators.
weaknesses: Not an ORM or a type-safe query builder.
data.setup_notes: Wrap an existing sqflite Database instance in a BriteDatabase.

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: Drift is a reactive, type-safe SQL database for Flutter and Dart with built-in migration support and generated code.

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: Sqflite is the standard non-reactive SQLite plugin if you do not need stream semantics.

alternatives.name: hive_ce
alternatives.why_pick_it: Hive CE is a lightweight key-value database if you do not require relational SQL features.
